description: Books a time on someone's Meetful booking link for the person using the assistant. Returns the meeting link, a calendar file and a private link to move or cancel; the owner is told an assistant made the booking. If the time was taken meanwhile, the error lists the nearest open times. No sign-in needed.

about.description: What they want to cover. It becomes the first item in the meeting.

answers.description: Answers to the booking page's own questions, by question id.

at.description: The start time, in ISO 8601 (like 2026-11-12T15:00:00Z) or epoch milliseconds.

email.description: Their email: the confirmation, the calendar file and the link to move it go there. Recommended.

link.description: The booking link, or just the name in it.

minutes.description: How long, if the page offers more than one length.

name.description: Who will be in the meeting — your person's name.

via.description: Your own name (Grok, ChatGPT, Claude…), so the owner knows which assistant booked.

name: book_time
title: Book a time
